data.name: Anamika
data.gender_notes: Anamika is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anamika is a name derived from Sanskrit, used in some Muslim communities. It refers to a companion of the Prophet or simply means 'without a name' or 'anonymous'. The name Anamika carries the meaning “Name of a companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Anamika usually hope their child will grow to embody name of a companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A divine gift, a soul that brings blessings and happiness to others
data.etymology: Anamika belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Name of a companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anamika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أناميكا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من أنام، يعني النعاس أو الخمول
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أناميكا هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من جذر أنم، والذي يعني النعاس أو الخمول. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر النوم كرمز للراحة والسكينة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء الجميلة والرقيقة التي تعبر عن الهدوء والسكينة.

in_urdu.name: انامیکا
in_urdu.meaning: انام سے مشتق، نیند یا سستی کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: انامیکا ایک خوبصورت اور نادر نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جذر انم سے لیا گیا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نیند یا سستی۔ یہ نام اردو بولنے والے ممالک میں خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں مقبول ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، نیند کو اللہ کی رحمت اور شفقت کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अनामिका
in_hindi.meaning: अनाम से व्युत्पन्न, नींद या आलस्य का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनामिका एक सुंदर और शांतिपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के मूल जذر أنم (आनाम) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है नींद या आलस्य। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम शांति और सुकून की भावना को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अक्सर उन बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो शांत और सौम्य स्वभाव के होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: انامیکا
in_pashto.meaning: د انام څخه مشتق شوی، د خوب یا سستۍ معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: انامیکا یو ښکلی او نرۍ نوم دی چی د انام څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چی د خوب یا سستۍ معنی ورکوي. په پښتني کلتور کې، خوب د الهي کرم او شفقت نښه ګڼل کیږي. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو مسلمینو ترمنځ مشهور دی.

data.cultural_impact: Anamika is a name that holds a unique place in both Muslim and Indian cultures. It is the name of the female protagonist in one of Urdu literature's most famous works, "Anarkali" by Ismail Merchant. The romantic tale of Anarkali and Salim depicts undying love and sacrifice. In Indian culture, it is a popular name in the Hindi-speaking world, known for its uniqueness and mystery.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Anamika holds a rich spiritual significance for Muslims due to its connection with the Prophet Muhammad PBUH. The word "Anamika" itself means 'without a name' or 'anonymous,' which is fitting for the Prophet, as one of his names is Al-A'rāf Al-'āzīz (The Most High and Exalted) and he is known to Muslims as Muhammad Rasūl Allāh (Muhammad, Prophet of Allah). By embracing this name, one can develop a deeper spiritual connection by focusing on the Prophet's humility and submission to Allah's will. Additionally, it may serve as a reminder to cherish the relationships we have and to be there for others, as if we were their devoted companion.
